description: Updates the active conversation to use a specific revision of the already-active strategy. Pass revisionId, or pass version with the user-facing version number (for example version=641) when the user asks to restore or pull up an exact historical version. If the user asks to work on a different owned strategy, call switch_active_strategy instead. For same-rules/copy-recent-changes tasks, do not use this to switch away from the source before reading the source strategy code; keep explicit source and target ids and read both saved codes before any edit. If the open/current strategy is the source, use the exact Strategy context ids from the Agent request for that attached source; do not fuzzy-search for another source by name.

revisionId.description: Exact AiStrategyRevision.id to activate. Omit when restoring by user-facing version number and pass version instead.

version.description: User-facing version number to restore (for example 641). Prefer this when the user names a historical version; the server resolves it to the owned revisionId.

name: set_strategy_revision
title: Switch conversation to a specific strategy revision
